initialization: Frozen train empirical whole-road initializer, once per seed; both arms restore the exact fleet and post-initialization PCG64 state
rng: One uniform per actor per maneuver in frozen vehicle order; same-seed common-prefix uniforms must be byte-identical across arms
cav_collision_reporting: not applicable: this is the all-natural NDE, not the separately conditioned IDM-CAV D2RL experiment
reference_scope: Same train exposure and 10 Hz marginal bins as frozen NDE; new seeds are independent Monte Carlo replications, not a new highD test set
bin_rule: Center bins with half-step edges and two explicit tails, identical in source and both arms; no adaptive binning or pseudocounts
joint_state_distance: Hellinger on fixed gap x relative-speed bins
mae: Mean absolute difference of normalized bin probability masses; not trajectory position/speed MAE
interaction: Leader/front first, follower/rear second; quantized effective forward 1 s accelerations, quiet stable leader/lane for both actors during previous 3 s and next 1 s, same as frozen interval reference selector
persistent_scope: Report strict 60 s common-pair counts. If source has no such tracks, those fidelity distances are unavailable; separately report 5 s windows with identical pair IDs persisting in both arms and source windows with the same duration/domain rule
censoring: Retain all 100 seeds including failures. Primary paired exposure uses each seed's common pre-terminal duration; separately report all available exposure and full-60s common survivors. Time tables report reached cohorts and common survivor counts

bootstrap.reference: fixed empirical highD reference; CI excludes source-data uncertainty

decision: Report paired delta and percentile CI. Require reductions in rr and joint-state H plus no detected speed/gap degradation. Non-significance alone does not establish noninferiority; no numeric noninferiority margin was supplied
